scripts.build: yarn clean && ../../node_modules/.bin/tsc -p tsconfig.json && ../../node_modules/.bin/tsc -p tsconfig.json --module esnext --outDir esm && node scripts/add-js-extensions.js lib && node scripts/add-js-extensions.js esm && cp src/theme.less lib/ && cp src/variables.less lib/ && find src -name '*.less' -exec cp --parents {} lib/ \; 2>/dev/null || find src -name '*.less' | cpio -pdm lib/ 2>/dev/null || true && for dir in lib/*/; do [ -f "${dir}index.js" ] && cp "${dir}index.js" "$(basename "$dir").js" 2>/dev/null || true; done
